args.sql: SELECT c.name, t.account, ROUND(SUM(t.amount-t.settled),2) AS past_due FROM erp_cust_trans t JOIN erp_customers c ON c.account=t.account WHERE t.txn_type='Invoice' AND t.closed=0 AND julianday('2026-03-02') - julianday(t.due_date) > 90 AND t.account='SYNCUS-0686' GROUP BY t.account ORDER BY past_due DESC LIMIT 10
